Brand Experience

The story behind the shine

Our Promise: Purity, Performance & Protection

Our Story

SPARKLEX HOME CARE began with a simple frustration — too many cleaning products promised results they couldn't deliver. Under EXARISTE GROUP, we set out to formulate detergents and surface care that genuinely perform, tested in real Bangladeshi homes and kitchens before ever reaching a shelf.

Mission: make premium-grade home hygiene affordable in every district. Vision: become Bangladesh's most trusted home care brand, recognised regionally.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Are SPARKLEX products safe for sensitive skin?

Yes. Our formulas are gentle on hands when used as directed, though we recommend gloves for extended use.

Where can I buy SPARKLEX products?

Through our growing distributor and retail network nationwide, and directly via our contact form.

How do I become a SPARKLEX distributor?

Use the Distributor Hub above to estimate profit and apply — our team responds within two business days.

Are the products biodegradable?

Most formulas, including the dishwashing bar, use biodegradable surfactants designed to break down responsibly.

Do you offer bulk pricing for institutions?

Yes, hotels, hospitals, schools and offices can request a custom quotation through our contact form.
